description: Create a deploy-only proposal for an existing account on an enabled network. The proposal makes a zero-value call to the account itself, so no funds move. Sign it via the returned signUrl or 'transactions sign <id>'; the account deploys only after the transaction executes.

workspace.description: Workspace alias to run this command in (see `splits auth workspaces`). Overrides SPLITS_WORKSPACE and the active workspace.

name: accounts_deploy
